description: Rules on main that still need a handbook page, one batch per family, for parallel writing. pending.yaml gives the reason for each. A batch writer adds only docs/handbook/rules/<RULE-ID>.yaml files for its own rules; it never edits pending.yaml, families.yaml, the intro chapters or the build script.
environment: Any Python environment with this checkout's dependencies installed (pip install -e .). The build puts the checkout it lives in first on PYTHONPATH, so one shared environment serves every worktree. Go rules need a skylos-go built from the same source: from the checkout root run (cd skylos/engines/go && go build -o ../../../build/skylos-go ./cmd/skylos-go), then export SKYLOS_GO_BIN="$PWD/build/skylos-go".
